title_en: Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow Launch Trailer Finally Confirms Release Date, Teases Fishing
summary_en: Team Cherry's latest showcase gives us a release date for Sea of Sorrow, the free DLC expansion coming to Hollow Knight: Silksong, and a launch trailer.
body_en:
Team Cherry has just wrapped up its Cherry Time! showcase, giving us some long-awaited news on the future of Hollow Knight: Silksong.
The big takeaway here is that Hollow Knight: Silksong's first big expansion, Sea of Sorrow, finally has a release date of December 11. Sea of Sorrow will be available to all Silksong players for free. All you need is a copy of the base game, and you can start playing Sea of Sorrow when it goes live on December 11.
This also means Team Cherry has stuck to its promise to get Sea of Sorrow out by the end of the year. Some had feared that today's announcement would be a delay — or an announcement that the DLC was being expanded into a full game, which is famously how Silksong's development began.
In the showcase, we got a new look at Sea of Sorrow's gameplay. This gives us a good preview of what's in store for us, as we see new areas, enemies, and boss fights. Of course, it all looks as challenging as ever, as you'd expect for Silksong's post-launch DLC. And is that a fishing mini-game teased at the end?
We weren't told anything else about the future of Silksong or the Hollow Knight series at large. There was no mention of this being Silksong's only expansion, so it's very possible that Team Cherry plans to support the game beyond Sea of Sorrow.
For now, here's the official blurb on Sea of Sorrow:
Outside of this reveal, Team Cherry used the attention to promote indie games from other studios. Three were shown off: Blockan and the Walking City, which is fully hand-drawn; Radio Rain, which is centred around 1980s-inspired music; and The Botanist and the Translator, which boasts a Sailor Moon-esque vibe.
In a follow-up blog post , Team Cherry confirmed that these new games will release under the new Team Cherry Presents label, which is headed up by the indie developer's fourth team member, Huy Le. Huy is technical director and on-going support for all the Team Cherry Presents games, but has also helped out on Silksong and Sea of Sorrow. "As a long-time team of three people, adding a fourth member is a big deal!" Team Cherry said.
